TraitDescription: Sand ginger is dry and sturdy, so it needs Heavy force to release its bold aroma.
Sand ginger forms the main flavor and should use the Large amount.
Dried tangerine peel is a familiar citrus accent and should stay at the Small amount.
Coarse salt is a strong supporting seasoning and needs only the Very Small amount.
